Profit after tax stood at ₹6.6 crores in FY 2025-26 as against ₹11.7 crores in FY 2024- 25.
Growth & demand: Today, with exports contributing 45.42% of our business, the Thread of Possibility continues to connect product development with long-term customer relationships, international growth, and a portfolio designed for the future.
Looking ahead, the Reserve Bank of India projects real GDP growth of 6.7% for FY 2026- 27, supported by continued domestic demand and investment activity.
Within this, man-made yarn, fabrics, and made-ups recorded export growth of 3.6%, reinforcing the growing demand for man-made fibre-based products and higher- value textile applications.
Margins & costs: I believe EBITDA can be improved by up-to 500 bps simply by building more robust processes across the board. • Deeper vendor development, project management and cost optimising in secondary costs - masterbatch, spin oils, freight, B-class Capex items, etc.
Operating EBITDA stood at ₹103.8 Crores, representing 7.6% of revenue, while lower finance costs reflected the Company's efforts towards prudent financial management and reduction in borrowings.
The cost of raw materials and changes in inventories is at 54.98% of revenue, which has decreased by 1.89% from 56.90% in previous year.
Capex & expansion: Several wins are worth celebrating: • W e fully commissioned our expansion in flooring yarns.
The commissioning of Floor Covering capacity and planned expansion in business are expected to enhance operating leverage, improve capacity utilisation and support long-term revenue growth.
At the same time, the Company continued to invest in its asset base, with fixed assets including capital work- in-progress increasing to ₹567.0 Crores.
Balance sheet & cash: Gross debt reduced to ₹187.8 Crores as at March 31, 2026, supported by repayment of borrowings and the deployment of proceeds from the preferential equity issue towards working capital requirements.
TOTAL DEBT Debt includes long-term, short-term borrowings including lease liabilities.
Gross Debt as on March 31, 2026, stands at ₹187.8 crore as against ₹201.8 crore at the end of FY 2024-25.
